body: Building off of https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/pull/388, this PR removes the keyword constructor for `SVDplusDCovariance`. This PR also removes `QuantileRegularization` which was only used in the keyword constructor for `SVDplusDCovariance`.
title: Remove keyword constructor for `SVDplusDCovariance` and `QuantileRegularization`
